title: Asparagus, Snow Pea, and Radish Salad
description: This elegant, seasonal, refreshing asparagus, snow pea, and radish salad recipe showcases delicate springtime vegetables in a bright lime vinaigrette.
ingredients: 1.25 pounds asparagus, trimmed and cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces
0.5 pound snow peas, ends and strings removed, cut diagonally into 1-inch pieces
15 small radishes, trimmed and thinly sliced
3 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice, or more to taste

steps.text: Fill a large saucepan with water; bring to a boil. Add asparagus; boil 1 minute. Add snow peas to pan with asparagus; boil 1 minute more. Drain and pat dry.
Transfer asparagus and snow peas to a large bowl. Add radishes, scallions, and dill; toss gently to combine.

Whisk oil, sugar, salt, and black pepper together in a small bowl; pour over salad and toss to coat. Set aside at room temperature to allow flavors to blend; about 1 hour. Drizzle lime juice over salad; toss gently to coat.
